title: Dialogue 5 opening: That the properties of deity and the glory are naturally in the Son
english: Dialogue 5 — That the properties of deity and the glory are naturally in the Son as in the Father.
A argues that whatever is proper to deity — life, light, glory, power — is in the Son by nature, not lent. The Son’s glory is not a borrowed brightness.
Hermias tracks how shared names of power mark one Godhead in Father and Son.

added_allusions.reason: Son does what Father does; honor the Son
glory with you before the world

translator_notes: Copy-text: PG 75 De sancta et consubstantiali Trinitate dialogi (CPG 5216).
True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Condensed lemma-led tip.
